recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-22852 unless a later work-group issue changes Basic.created again.
issue_request: FHIR-22852 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Basic change request asking that Basic.created be corrected from date to dateTime so the element can support ordering resource instances by time.
initial_application: The issue was previously applied for R5. Jira records the fix as merge commit 645c1c64fe86f0d2b05995614505201c497934f6, and implementation commit 07488999193be8c166d587073cf855234c11fa43 changed source/basic/structuredefinition-Basic.xml from date to dateTime for Basic.created.
additional_context: Basic is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/basic/structuredefinition-Basic.xml is in current build scope. The Basic-created SearchParameter still uses FHIR search type date for Basic.created, which is consistent with date/dateTime search semantics and does not contradict the element datatype. FHIR-I minutes from 2019-08-05 confirm the work-group agreement and 4-0-0 vote, and a 2018 Zulip thread provides background without conflicting with the later fix.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the authoritative current source already contains the requested dateTime datatype and the combined branch did not already have an FHIR-22852 audit commit.
